description: Report the fmsg address this server acts as, its owner if it is a sub-address, the fmsg Web API URL and how short names resolve, and this server's version and build. Call this first if unsure who you are sending as.
name: whoami

directory_names.description: short names in the operator-configured directory; empty when there are none

owner.description: owner of this sub-address, included as a recipient of messages you send unless include_owner is false; absent for an owner's own address

server_build.description: git describe of the build, such as v1.2.3-4-g80e0418, when recorded

server_commit.description: the git commit this server was built from, when the build recorded it

token_expires_at.description: internal: when the server's current upstream access token expires; it is renewed automatically, so no action is needed

transport.description: one of "stdio", "http"; http is Streamable HTTP. More values may be added

title: Show fmsg identity
